meta.title: Wordstat — 市场需求情报
meta.description: 按国家分析 IT 服务与数字产品的需求、竞争与利润潜力

dashboard.title: Market overview
dashboard.subtitle: Key demand signals for IT services and digital products (2025–2026 estimates)
dashboard.disclaimer: Catalog may mix expert_estimate rows and live Google Trends (relative interest 0–100, not absolute volume).

markets.title: IT 与数字产品市场分析
markets.subtitle: 覆盖所有细分与主要国家的现成概览。无需选择 — 数据自动采集。
markets.disclaimer: Google Trends = relative interest 0–100, not absolute volume. Full refresh across niches×countries runs in the background (cron or button) and takes time due to Google rate limits.
markets.refreshStarted: Background refresh started. Later click Reload screen.
markets.byCountryHint: Aggregate score and top niche per country
markets.matrixHint: Sorted by score. Source: expert_estimate and/or google_trends.
markets.risingHint: Aggregated rising related queries from recent live runs
markets.risingEmpty: No live Rising yet — click Rebuild Trends or wait for nightly cron.
markets.empty: No rows yet — start a Trends rebuild.

research.title: Custom query (advanced)
research.subtitle: Manual single-query deep dive. For IT/digital market overview use Markets.
research.disclaimer: Google Trends = relative interest 0–100. For SerpAPI/DataForSEO/Ahrefs add your own keys in Cabinet (Pro).
research.noPoints: No interest points (rate limit or empty response)

settings.title: Data source settings
settings.subtitle: Provider and API keys. Secrets live in SQLite on the server, not in git.
settings.keysHint: Leave a secret field empty to keep the stored value.
settings.subtitleAdmin: Admin: catalog refresh worker only. User keys are not stored here.
settings.byokNote: Users add their own provider keys in the Cabinet →
settings.providerCatalogHint: Catalog Markets refresh must stay on google_trends (no platform paid keys).

opportunities.title: Opportunity table
opportunities.subtitle: Filter and sort clusters to decide fast: launch, test, or wait

insights.title: Insights & recommendations
insights.subtitle: 5–7 directions with the best demand / competition / margin mix

admin.title: Data management
admin.subtitle: Add and update clusters. Changes write to local SQLite.

auth.loginSubtitle: 访问控制台、密钥与套餐
auth.registerSubtitle: 免费套餐含 Google Trends。升级后可使用个人 API 密钥。
auth.name: 名称
auth.successRegister: 账户已创建 — 已登录

cabinet.title: 控制台
cabinet.subtitle: Your plan, limits, and your own API keys
cabinet.freeHint: Free = Google Trends tool only. Pro unlocks attaching your own paid provider keys.
cabinet.proOnly: Pro required to save and use your paid provider keys.
cabinet.keysHint: Leave a field empty to keep the current key. Paste a new value to replace.
cabinet.byokLead: Wordstat is the tool. We do not sell or lend SerpAPI / DataForSEO / Ahrefs credits — you connect keys from your own accounts.
cabinet.byokBullet2: Pro: paste your SerpAPI / DataForSEO / Ahrefs keys here; research runs on your quota.
cabinet.byokBullet3: Keys are encrypted at rest and never shared with other users.
cabinet.serpapiHelp: Create a key at serpapi.com — used for Google Trends via SerpAPI.
cabinet.ahrefsHelp: Ahrefs API token from your Ahrefs account.

billing.title: 账单
billing.freeFeatures: Shared Markets · Google Trends tool · daily limits
billing.proFeatures: Your own API keys · higher limits · personal history. Keys are not included in the plan.
billing.stripeMissing: Stripe is not configured yet — ask admin.
